title: Bedwars Optimised
description: Modpack with optimisation mods and bedwars-specific mods to make playing Hypixel Bedwars as simple as possible.
body:
Contains performance optimising mods and bedwars-specific gameplay helpers, while keeping the mod list as unbloated as possible.

## Performance:
- Entity Culling and Redirectionor are included
- I tested half a dozen other optimisation mods and they all either worsened performance or did nothing. Tested mods include Ksyxis, Phosphor Legacy Forge, BetterFPS, and FoamFix.

## Bedwars Specific:
- BedWar Mod
  - Adds resource tracking overlays and summarises your game stats so you can see how you're doing.
- Mellow
  - Adds other players' bedwars stats (star level, FKDR, winstreak) to tablist.
- TNT Countdown
  - So you can see at a glance how long you have left until the TNT explodes.
## Miscellaneous  Information:
  
In addition, some general quality of life mods (such as toggle-sprint, zoom, etc) are included.

This modpack will not make you better at bedwars if you have a skill issue, it does not include cheats. Do not download this modpack expecting to suddenly start winning games, it simply provides some bedwars-specific QOL features.

Please report any issues and suggest changes/additions on the linked [Discord server](https://discord.gg/NGA3ZSHqEY).

## External Mods:
This modpack bundles [Redirector](https://github.com/MCTeamPotato/Redirector/tree/1.12.2-1.8.8?tab=readme-ov-file), which is licenced LGPL and thus permits bundling.

I also recommend using a mod such as [HitDelayFix](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/hit-delay-fix), however no such mod currently exists on modrinth or with an open licence, so you will have to download it seperately.
